messages:
alice: Heads up — promotion to prod is blocked, CI failing at artifact publish step after cache index update.
ben: Seeing same in pipeline, error shows checksum mismatch when pushing manifest to GCS.
deploy-bot: Release job 2026-03-20T15:04:12Z FAILED (step: publish-artifact). See <https://ci.internal/runs/4587|run 4587>.
carla: Paste of last logs: ```Uploading artifact to gs://redwood-artifacts/prod/llm-runtime:sha-abc123
MD5 mismatch: expected=5d41402abc, actual=9f86d08188
Aborting upload and marking artifact as corrupt```
dinesh: That MD5 is coming from the cache indexer that computes content digests. We pushed an indexer change yesterday that changed canonicalization for symlinked files. Could be double-counting metadata.
alice: Can we triage quickly? This is blocking the 2.4.1 rollout during the change window. Maya, do you want to hold the rollout? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: Hold. Put release on hold until we confirm artifact integrity. Notify customers on the change window channel.
ben: Quick check: `gsutil ls -L gs://redwood-artifacts/prod/llm-runtime:sha-abc123` shows object exists but checksum different from local job. Suspect local index produced wrong manifest and CI aborted to avoid promoting bad artifact.
carla: Reproducer on my laptop: indexer v1.2.0 -> produced manifest A (md5 X). indexer v1.2.1 -> produced manifest B (md5 Y). When the upload client validated using A but indexer changed to B mid-run, CI fails.
dinesh: I can revert the indexer change quickly to v1.2.0 and rerun the publish job. Would that be acceptable?
maya: If revert is low-risk and we can republish tonight, do it. Otherwise we pin the image to previous sha and cut a hotfix window.
alice: Revert sounds fastest. Ben, can you start a revert rollback and run a canary publish in staging?
ben: Starting revert PR now. Logging commands: ```git revert --no-commit <commit-hash>
./ci/publish.sh --dry-run --target=staging```
ben: Canary publish in staging succeeded, checksum matched. CI job 4588 passed.
carla: Nice. We should add a guard so indexer changes require a manifest-stability check before enabling new canonicalization. Filed a quick ticket: https://tickets/internal/RED-7891
dinesh: Pushing revert to prod indexer fleet in 5. Will monitor.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: indexer-service v1.2.0 -> 1.2.0 (rollback applied). Tracking: <https://deploys.internal/roll/1122>.
alice: After revert, we should re-run the release promotion for run 4587. Ben, can you re-trigger?
ben: Retrying publish... job 4590 triggered. Monitor: logs show upload -> verification -> promoted. ✅
maya: Great. Unhold release, proceed with rollout but keep monitoring for 30m. If we see any more checksum mismatches, pause and rollback.
carla: Postmortem note: short-term revert applied. Action items: 1) add manifest-stability integration test, 2) add checksum alert to release dashboard, 3) document indexer canonicalization change process.
alice: I'll DM legal/ops about customer-facing note if anyone wants to craft wording.
dinesh: Will follow up with a PR that adds the stability test and a config toggle so canonicalization is opt-in behind a flag.
ben: Closing loop: release promoted at 15:27Z, no rollback needed. Leaving release notes draft in #release-notes for Maya to review. :party_parrot:
